verdict: Leads are arriving at a strong cost — but none are entering the pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 167 leads at $12.67 per lead, well below the July baseline range of $19–$45, so the ad campaign is performing efficiently. However, 142 of those contacts show up in your CRM with zero opportunities created and zero appointments — meaning leads are coming in but not being worked, which is an intake process gap, not an ads problem. We are addressing the CRM pipeline flow directly this period to close that gap. On the organic side, Google Business Profile actions dropped 31% week-over-week, a trend we're moving to reverse by getting a consistent posting cadence live. You should expect pipeline visibility to improve as the CRM corrections take hold over the next week.
